# App icons and banners

The 👽 in the launcher icons (`mipmap-*/ic_launcher.png`) and TV banners
(`drawable-xhdpi/tv_banner.png`) of `app` and `installer` is the "alien" emoji of
**Noto Color Emoji** (Google), rendered onto a gradient. Noto Color Emoji is licensed under
the SIL Open Font License 1.1 (https://openfontlicense.org), its artwork under the Apache
License 2.0 (https://github.com/googlefonts/noto-emoji). The banner text is set in Toolkit
Heros (see `../tex-gyre-heros`).
